You become attuned to subtle cues, needs, and emotions that you might otherwise overlook. Over time, this heightened sensitivity can make you more compassionate in your professional life, in friendships, and even in your own self‑care. ### 4. **Prioritization and Value Clarification** Deciding what to cook, what to schedule, and what to let go of forces you to clarify what truly matters.
